nodes.description: msg.sender - caller address that supplies funds, receives shares, and triggers deposit/withdraw/redeem flows
block.timestamp (now) used to build Uniswap swap deadlines via now.add(1800)
pool: cached pool value in DAI used for share pricing
YELD ERC20 token used for staking reward transfers and burn accounting
IYeldDAI instance used for mint/burn/price/decimals queries
mapping(address => uint256) tracking staked DAI per user
mapping(address => uint256) tracking deposited yDAI per user
payable treasury address receiving ETH profit transfers
Uniswap router address used for token swaps
cap on YELD tokens burned from staking profits
underlying DAI token address
deposit(uint256) external nonReentrant: pulls DAI, mints yDAI, mints shares
withdraw(uint256) external nonReentrant: burns shares, pulls funds, converts profits and transfers DAI
redeemYeld(): burns deposited yDAI and transfers YELD rewards to msg.sender
checkIfRedeemableBalance() public view: returns whether caller holds yDAI
daiToETH(uint256) internal: swaps DAI for ETH via Uniswap router
buyNBurn(uint256) internal: swaps ETH for YELD via Uniswap router
setUniswapRouter(address) public onlyOwner: updates router address
extractTokensIfStuck(address,uint256) public onlyOwner: transfers arbitrary tokens out
extractETHIfStuck() public onlyOwner: sends contract ETH balance to owner
approveToken() public: grants unlimited token approvals to lending protocols
IERC20(token).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _amount) - external token pull
yeldDAIInstance.mint(msg.sender, yeldDAIToReceive) - external mint call
_mint(msg.sender, shares) - share accounting update
yeldDAIInstance.burn(msg.sender, deposited[msg.sender]) and yeldToken.transfer(msg.sender, yeldToRedeem)
IUniswap(uniswapRouter).swapExactTokensForETH(...) - external swap with timestamp deadline
IUniswap(uniswapRouter).swapExactETHForTokens.value(_ethToSwap)(...) - external value-carrying swap
retirementYeldTreasury.transfer(retirementYeld) - ETH transfer to treasury
IERC20(token).safeTransfer(msg.sender, r) - external token transfer to user
IERC20(_token).transfer(msg.sender, _amount) - arbitrary token transfer by owner
owner().transfer(address(this).balance) - ETH send to owner
uniswapRouter = _uniswapRouter - privileged router state assignment
_amount parameter of deposit: DAI amount supplied by caller
shares local in deposit: minted share amount derived from pool math
_shares parameter of withdraw: shares burned by caller
halfProfits local in withdraw: (r.sub(staked[msg.sender])).div(2)
_ethToSwap parameter of buyNBurn: ETH used to buy YELD
_uniswapRouter parameter of setUniswapRouter
_token parameter of extractTokensIfStuck

_token selects which token is transferred out

normalization_plan.reason: _amount parameter only exists to feed the deposit function state changes and external calls
shares is a transient local computed and consumed entirely within deposit
_shares parameter only drives the withdraw function burn and transfer logic
halfProfits is a transient local used only inside withdraw profit conversion
_ethToSwap parameter only exists to be forwarded to the Uniswap swap call
_uniswapRouter parameter only exists to be assigned to the router state variable
_token parameter only selects the asset for the owner-only transfer out
